main_text.p: Quare non adulteris tantum,sed fcortatö ribus quibuslibet pœna denunciatur. Verbum enim Dei per copulam,&,hoc loco eos in pœna conjungit.Licet autem omnes pœ-nę,quæ etiam per magistratum infliguntur, divinæ pœnæ sint: tamen hoc non finefin-gulari quadam emphasi dicitur, quòd talia peccata Deus ipse judicabit,id est,damnabit ac puniet.q.d.quem omnino nihil latet,quique solus verè & perfectè punire potest. Cu-jus denique judicia minimè cessant, etsi nemo hominum manum admoveat. Fortè e-tiam simul respicit summam negligentiam in magistratus in puniendis talibus flagitiis,ac si diceret: Nolite propterea securi esse,quòd non punimini à magistratu,ob turpitudines, aut quia etiam ipsimet magistratus sese eis contaminant,easque non improbant.

Erit enim profecto, qui tales omnes feverif-fimè puniat: juxta illud πολυθεύκτος[?], Gott richtet/wenn niemand spricht, 1.Corinth.11.Sic Ephes.5. inquit: Propter talia venit ira Dei super filios inobedientiæ. Et Propheta Malac.2.ait, Excindet Dominus virum,qui hoc fecerit,&c. Sic olim diluvii aquis conjugii prophanationem, & quæ ex illa enata fuerunt scelera,eluit, cum nemo esset, qui de illis tollendis cogitaret. Idem suam manum illis intulit, qui Madianitarum filiabus commixti fuerant. Taceo quæ ex prophanis historiis adduci possent exempla, & quæ ipsi adulte-ris & fœdis conjugii prophanatoribus in-

page.notes: The Greek word after "juxta illud" is only partly legible; the accents and final letters are doubtful, so it is marked [?]. "finefin-" in "non finefin-gulari" is doubtful as printed. "negligentiam in magistratus" is a doubtful reading of the line join. The German phrase "Gott richtet, wenn niemand spricht" is set in black letter, and the "f" forms are read as long s. The word "dies" at the foot is the catchword for the next page. No italic type was clearly visible on this page.
